title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — November 05, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B8.5)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.3 (Peaked November 05, 2026 at 22:31 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 318 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Type II Radio Emission

Something just made some noise on solar radio! 📻☀️📡🔆🌌

Solar images show several bright active regions and a broad dark coronal feature; the coronagraph view appears otherwise routine.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 94/335/193 Å Composite
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
